title: Shift compatibility of the ordinary coefficient map
statement: Let A,E,C be commutative rings in one universe, f:A→E and g:E→C ring maps, K,L A-module cochain complexes, n,i integers and e:L ≅ K[-n]. Let tauK:F_E K→G_E(F_C K) and tauL:F_E L→G_E(F_C L) send a ⊗ x to g(a) ⊗ x in every degree (a in E), where F_E,F_C extend along f,g∘f and G_E restricts along g. Let eE and eC be the prescribed ordinary homology shift isomorphisms from e at degree i+n to degree i, and let muK,muL be restriction/homology isomorphisms. Then H^(i+n)(tauL) followed by muL and G(eC) equals eE followed by H^i(tauK) and muK. No derived categories, cohomology actions, models or localized comparison maps are assumed.

proof.text: Let F_E and F_C be termwise extension along f and g∘f, G restriction along g, and G_E its termwise functor. Form the prescribed complex shift isomorphisms cE and cC from e. Put cG=G_E(cC) followed by the canonical restriction shift isomorphism. HomologicalComplex.Hom.ext and ExtendScalars.hom_ext reduce tauL followed by cG = cE followed by tauK[-n] to pure tensors. The generator formulas hL,hK and ExtendScalars.map_tmul prove the equality. The proved ModuleCat.extendScalars_additive instance supplied by the model module gives the canonical extension shift maps used in the statement.

Use G.mapHomologicalComplexHomologyIso for the exact restriction functor G. Unfold its definition to identify its components with (Q.sc j).mapHomologyIso G. The proved upstream lemma CategoryTheory.Functor.mapHomologicalComplexHomologyIso_hom_app_shiftIso, in WeilConjectures.Mathlib.Algebra.Homology.HomotopyCategory.ShiftSequence, gives compatibility with the prescribed homology shift. Cancel homology of the inverse restriction shift map to orient this compatibility in the needed direction.

Naturality of G.mapHomologicalComplexHomologyIso moves restriction/homology past cC. Substitute its shift compatibility, combine the homology maps by HE.map_comp, and substitute the complex square from step 1. Naturality of CochainComplex.ShiftSequence.shiftIso for tauK moves its shifted homology map past the shift isomorphism. Category associativity yields precisely the displayed coefficient square. The Lean proof is complete; no derived-model transport is imported or used.

lean.statement:
theorem tensorCoefficient_shift_homology
    (f : A →+* E) (g : E →+* C)
    (K L : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ) (n : ℤ) (e : L ≅ K⟦-n⟧)
    (τK : ((extendScalars f).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj K ⟶
      ((restrictScalars g).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
        (((extendScalars (g.comp f)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj K))
    (τL : ((extendScalars f).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj L ⟶
      ((restrictScalars g).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
        (((extendScalars (g.comp f)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj L))
    (hK : ∀ (j : ℤ) (a : E) (x : K.X j),
      τK.f j (a ⊗ₜ[A,f] x) = g a ⊗ₜ[A,g.comp f] x)
    (hL : ∀ (j : ℤ) (a : E) (x : L.X j),
      τL.f j (a ⊗ₜ[A,f] x) = g a ⊗ₜ[A,g.comp f] x) (i : ℤ) :
    let FE := (extendScalars.{u, u, u} f).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)
    let FC := (extendScalars.{u, u, u} (g.comp f)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)
    let G := restrictScalars.{u} g
    let eE := (HomologicalComplex.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} E) (.up ℤ)
      (i + n)).mapIso (FE.mapIso e ≪≫ (FE.commShiftIso (-n)).app K) ≪≫
      (CochainComplex.ShiftSequence.shiftIso (ModuleCat.{u} E) (-n) (i + n) i
        (by omega)).app (FE.obj K)
    let eC := (HomologicalComplex.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} C) (.up ℤ)
      (i + n)).mapIso (FC.mapIso e ≪≫ (FC.commShiftIso (-n)).app K) ≪≫
      (CochainComplex.ShiftSequence.shiftIso (ModuleCat.{u} C) (-n) (i + n) i
        (by omega)).app (FC.obj K)
    HomologicalComplex.homologyMap τL (i + n) ≫
        ((FC.obj L).sc (i + n) |>.mapHomologyIso G).hom ≫ G.map eC.hom =
      eE.hom ≫ HomologicalComplex.homologyMap τK i ≫
        ((FC.obj K).sc i |>.mapHomologyIso G).hom
